name: implied_vol_dislocation_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: When India VIX (implied vol) diverges significantly from Nifty50 realized vol (last 20 days annualized), a correction is imminent. If VIX > 1.3 * realized_vol, the market is overpricing fear -- BUY_CE on NIFTY50 index options. If VIX < 0.8 * realized_vol, the market is underpricing risk -- BUY_PE on NIFTY50 index options. This inefficiency exists because options market makers set implied vol based on order flow and hedging needs, not pure statistical forecasting. Edge persists because the IV-RV spread requires cross-asset analysis most equity traders don't perform.

indicators.name: rv_20d
indicators.formula: annualized realized vol of Nifty50 over last 20 trading days

indicators.name: nifty_return_360
indicators.purpose: short-term index direction (360 bars = 30 min at 5s)

indicators.name: vix_slope_12
indicators.formula: linear regression slope of VIX over last 12 bars (60 seconds)

long.confirmation: VIX starts declining for 6 consecutive 5s bars (30 seconds of VIX decline)

short.confirmation: VIX starts rising for 6 consecutive 5s bars (30 seconds of VIX rise)

exit.time_stop: exit after 12 bars (60 seconds) if no progress

filters.time_filter: entry only 09:20-14:00 IST (need time for mean reversion to play out)
filters.event_filter: skip on RBI policy day, budget day

edge.edge_decay_risk: low -- IV-RV spread is driven by options market structure, slow to change

mechanism: At 5-second frequency, the IV-RV dislocation signal is sampled from a daily-computed ratio (slow-moving), but the ENTRY TIMING benefits from 5s granularity. The VIX micro-trend (6 consecutive declining/rising 5s bars = 30 seconds) provides precise entry confirmation that avoids false triggers visible on 1-minute charts. The option premium (CE/PE) responds to VIX moves with sub-second latency, so entering on the 5s VIX slope reversal captures the first move of the dislocation unwind. Hold time is short (5-60 seconds) because we are scalping the initial option premium adjustment, not waiting for full IV-RV convergence.
adaptation_notes: Adapted from 1-min equity strategy to 5-sec index option strategy. Key changes: (1) Universe changed from top-15-beta stocks to NIFTY50 ATM/OTM index options (CE/PE), (2) Lookback for nifty_return adjusted from 30 bars to 360 bars (equivalent 30 min at 5s), (3) VIX confirmation changed from 3 consecutive 1-min bars to 6 consecutive 5s bars (30 seconds), (4) Removed stock_filter as we trade index options directly, (5) Hold time compressed from 60-200 minutes to 5-60 seconds -- we scalp the initial premium reaction rather than waiting for full mean reversion, (6) Entry/exit now reference option premium (BUY_CE/BUY_PE) instead of equity BUY/SHORT.
weaknesses: IV-RV dislocation can persist for days/weeks -- intraday resolution is not guaranteed
Using a daily input (20-day RV) in a 5-second strategy creates a mismatch in signal granularity
Very low frequency -- dislocation signals fire maybe 3-5 times per month
prior_art: Implied-realized volatility spread trade -- standard options/vol arb concept. Applied here to index option direction.
notes: More suitable as a regime overlay than a standalone strategy. Combine with other setups. Adapted for 5-second NIFTY50 index option trading.
